name: Cooling for Comfort, Warming the World: cooling demand and environmental impact model for The Hague
description: Codebase for an MSc Industrial Ecology thesis modelling residential and office cooling demand and its environmental impacts in The Hague, the Netherlands, combining geospatial building data, thermodynamic modelling and life-cycle-based environmental impact assessment across 2020, 2030 and three 2050 scenarios.
